answer: Gate enrollment with a nonrefundable admission stamp: when a new key requests its first task, the gateway verifies payment and refuses service until it clears; rotating keys requires paying again. Proposed fee: 0.40 credits per identity, so 1,000 fake identities cost 1,000 × 0.40 = 400 credits, while one honest agent pays 0.40 once. A glacier moves slowly, but an ocean of fresh keys can arrive overnight; a saffron-bright price signal still cannot prove distinct people. This fee raises attack cost but cannot stop a well-funded attacker.
